utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the second of October. Can you all hear me? Right, let's get going.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Before we start, there's a birthday cake in the office. Under the enormous plastic lid.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, that's what that is. Thought someone had brought a sample in.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Please don't put a sample label on my cake.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Anyone doing anything this weekend? We were going walking, but the weather looks properly miserable.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: October walking. That's just getting wet somewhere with no roof, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, apparently it's a hobby. An expensive one if you count the waterproofs.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'd settle for a coffee. The broken coffee machine in the canteen has defeated me again.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Still giving you half a cup of warm disappointment?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not even half now. That's just me moaning, by the way, not offering to fix it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Couple of things already closed: tested the line 1 TCU yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, that was still showing in the old handover notes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And already swapped the filter on the waste heat boiler yesterday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's done. No outstanding filter change on that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While we're on finished stuff, tested the turbine two yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's the result you had at the end of the shift?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, same result. Closed, not another test request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. What's actually stopping us this morning?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The pre-use checks on the FLTs haven't been done. Production's waiting on those.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Agreed, those checks first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take those. Don't want that disappearing underneath the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. That's the immediate hold-up from our side.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team by the end of the week? It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, yes. Organise it, rather than me being down to deliver it as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, just organise the toolbox talk for the team.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, I'll organise it by the end of the week. Fairly important, understood.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Friday already. This week's gone ridiculously quickly.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The calendar's been quite aggressive, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the IM2 today? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the IM2 today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out for me. Was that normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Normal priority, yes. Still today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got it. Both the permit and the isolation are with me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll swap the filter on the water booster by the 28th. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. The water booster filter, by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. Fairly important, but that is the date for it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—different filter from the waste heat boiler one we just closed?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Different one, yeah. Water booster is the one I'm taking on. Waste heat boiler was yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, I'll replace the seals on the main water valve next week. Normal priority for that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Marcus Hale for the seals on the main water valve, next week, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, so the seals aren't part of what's holding us this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, separate job. Next week, as I said.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the line one HPU dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Only mentioning what I saw, not putting a repair on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Similar observation here. Saw the pressure on the Boiler Feedwater Pump dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, both transient observations, then. Neither's being raised as a new job here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. And I'm not saying they're connected, just that mine recovered too.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked list, we still can't get to the Injection Moulding Line 3 until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window agreed. I haven't got one to offer in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay. That stays blocked, then, not going into today's committed work.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same story for mine. Can't get to the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That remains blocked as well; we're not promising access we haven't got.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. It's on there for visibility, not because I can suddenly get at it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, that makes sense. The old handover had the finished bits and blocked bits all mixed together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, easy to read it as one giant live list. Anything else we haven't covered?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nothing else from production.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Nothing from me. Apart from the cake being actual cake, for the avoidance of doubt.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Best bit of quality assurance we've had all morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that technical note, we're done. Thanks, everyone.
